newsitem.title: USA: IES Iowa nuke seen at full power on weekend.
newsitem.headline: IES Iowa nuke seen at full power on weekend.

text.p: IES Utilities Inc's 538 megawatt Duane Arnold nuclear power plant in Palo, Iowa, is likely to reach full electricity output over the weekend following an outage, a company spokesman said Wednesday.
"It should be back at full power sometime this weekend," company spokesman Tom Petersen said.
The unit was holding power output to about 33 percent of capacity as of Wednesday morning for restart testing, the spokesman said.
Duane Arnold was shut Oct 11 for 35 days of scheduled refueling and maintenance, but returned to service a few days earlier than originally expected.
IES Utilities is a subsidiary of IES Industries Inc.
